title: Bathrooms.
officialText: Rooms containing bathtubs, showers, spas and similar bathing fixtures in other than R and I-1 occupancies shall be mechanically ventilated in accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code, whether or not they are also provided with natural ventilation.
